capture.final_message:
Split the conjunction.

- For the first statement, view it as the commutativity of the canonical square
  \[
  H_j(K)\longrightarrow \operatorname{opcycles}_j(K)
  \]
  after identifying the homology and opcycles of \(K\) with those of the associated short complex \(K_i\to K_j\to K_k\). The equalities `hi` and `hk` identify the neighboring indices, and `homologyIsoSc'` is constructed compatibly with `opcyclesIsoSc'`. Use the defining/universal-property characterization of `homologyι`—or the corresponding compatibility lemma for these isomorphisms—to obtain the displayed equality.

- For the second statement, reduce both sides pointwise in \(i\). Use the standard local characterization that the short complex around \(i\) is exact exactly when its homology object is zero. Then `Acyclic K`, meaning all homology objects of \(K\) vanish, is equivalent to `ExactAt K i` for every \(i\).

Thus the main mechanism is passage from a homological complex to its local three-term short complexes, together with the canonical homology/opcycles identifications and the equivalence “zero homology ⇔ exact.”
